title: fix: rbac v2 KMS region-pinning audit log missing region field when enforcement enabled
author: Aisha Kapoor
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky on first run (kv-cache-ttl) -> rerun -> pass
description:
Context: RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning introduced a regression where some audit log entries emitted during KMS-bound operations omitted the kms_region field when enforcement was turned on. This caused downstream residency reports and compliance tooling to mark resources as 'unattributed' and broke a subset of automated audits.

Root cause: When enforcement is enabled we short-circuit the request path earlier to validate region constraints; the audit context builder was not populated in the enforcement branch, so kms_region was never attached to the AuditEvent for those code paths.

What this PR does: Fixes the audit-context population in the enforcement path and adds defensive checks when constructing AuditEvent payloads. Key changes: ensure kms_region is read from the KMS policy evaluator when present, attach region to both request-scoped and persisted audit events, and add unit/integration tests covering enforcement and non-enforcement flows.

Files touched: small, targeted changes in rbac/kms enforcement and audit modules plus tests. No public API changes.

Testing & validation: added unit tests for audit payload composition, integration test that simulates KMS region pinning enforcement and validates emitted audit entries, and manual verification against the residency report generator. CI showed one flaky integration test (kv-cache TTL) which was rerun and passed.

Rollout: Canary rolled out to 10% of production traffic for 24h, monitoring residency reports and audit event counts. No anomalies observed. Full rollout completed via squash merge.

Migration notes: None. Downstream compliance systems that previously received 'unattributed' entries will gradually receive corrected events for new operations; historical unattributed events remain unchanged.

References: Linear ENG-4321, support ticket SUP-2043, related PRs pr-214914 and pr-214915 (audit fixes).
